subject_uz: Pompe kasalligini davolash uchun alglyukozidaza-alfa 50 mg dori vositasi (726 flakon)

requirements.summary_uz: Dori vositasi infuziya eritmasi uchun liofilizat, 50 mg li 1 flakon o'lchov birligida bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The medicine must be a lyophilisate for infusion solution concentrate, supplied as 50 mg vials.

requirements.summary_uz: Dori vositasi GMP talablari bo'yicha sertifikatlangan ishlab chiqarish maydonchasida ishlab chiqarilgan bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The medicine must be made at a manufacturing site certified to GMP requirements.
requirements.quote: Dori vositasi GMP talablari bo'yicha seгtifi katlangan ishlab chiqarish maydonchasida

requirements.summary_uz: Ikkilamchi qadoqda 'Sotish taqiqlanadi' yozuvi, davlat va rus tillarida tamg'alash hamda raqamli markirovka bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Secondary packaging must carry a 'not for sale' notice, labelling in Uzbek and Russian, and digital marking.

requirements.summary_uz: 2026 yil uchun ajratilgan mablag' asosida 732 dona flakon (50 mg) yetkazib beriladi; e'londa 726 dona ko'rsatilgan.
requirements.summary_en: The specification states 732 vials (50 mg) for 2026, while the lot header lists 726 units.
requirements.quote: 2026 yil uсhuп ajratilgan mablag' asosida 732 dona flakon (50 mg) miqdori.

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib berish kunida qoldiq yaroqlilik muddati umumiy muddatdan belgilangan foizdan ko'proq qisqargan bo'lmasligi kerak (2 yilgacha 30%, 3 yilgacha 40%, undan ortiq 50%).
requirements.summary_en: Remaining shelf life at delivery may not have shortened by more than 30% / 40% / 50% depending on total shelf life.

requirements.summary_uz: Ulgurji savdo qiluvchi ishtirokchi GDP muvofiqlik sertifikati va amaldagi litsenziyaga ega bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Wholesale participants must hold a GDP conformity certificate and a valid licence.

requirements.summary_uz: Orfan preparatlar uchun ishlab chiqaruvchi mamlakat tartibga soluvchi organida ro'yxatdan o'tish talab qilinadi, O'zbekistonda ro'yxatdan o'tish majburiy emas.
requirements.summary_en: Orphan medicines must be registered with the manufacturer country's regulator; Uzbek registration is not mandatory.

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir partiya bilan seriya bo'yicha tahlil sertifikati, sifat pasporti va sinov uchun qo'shimcha namunalar taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Each batch must come with a certificate of analysis, quality passport and extra samples for certification testing.
